Here’s a table of the **top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq-100 (NDX)** as of the latest available data (June 2024), including their **market capitalization** and **P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratio**.

*Note:* Market caps and P/E ratios fluctuate daily. For the most up-to-date figures, check financial sources like **Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, or the official Nasdaq website**.

| **Rank** | **Company**               | **Ticker** | **Market Cap (USD)** | **P/E Ratio (TTM)** | **Weight in NDX (%)** |
|----------|---------------------------|------------|----------------------|---------------------|-----------------------|
| 1        | Microsoft                 | MSFT       | ~$3.2 trillion       | ~38                 | ~9.5%                 |
| 2        | Apple                     | AAPL       | ~$3.1 trillion       | ~32                 | ~8.5%                 |
| 3        | NVIDIA                    | NVDA       | ~$3.0 trillion       | ~75                 | ~7.5%                 |
| 4        | Amazon                    | AMZN       | ~$1.9 trillion       | ~55                 | ~5.5%                 |
| 5        | Meta (Facebook)           | META       | ~$1.3 trillion       | ~28                 | ~4.5%                 |
| 6        | Alphabet (Google) - Class A | GOOGL    | ~$2.2 trillion       | ~28                 | ~4.0%                 |
| 7        | Alphabet (Google) - Class C | GOOG     | ~$2.2 trillion       | ~28                 | ~3.5%                 |
| 8        | Tesla                     | TSLA       | ~$550 billion        | ~45                 | ~2.5%                 |
| 9        | Broadcom                  | AVGO       | ~$500 billion        | ~50                 | ~2.3%                 |
| 10       | Costco                    | COST       | ~$350 billion        | ~55                 | ~2.0%                 |

### **Key Notes:**
1. **Market Cap & P/E Data** – Based on trailing twelve months (TTM) as of mid-2024.
2. **Weight in NDX** – The Nasdaq-100 is **market-cap weighted**, so larger companies have a bigger impact.
3. **Recent Changes** – NVIDIA has surged in weight due to AI-driven growth, while Tesla’s weight has declined.
4. **P/E Variations** – Tech stocks often have higher P/E ratios due to growth expectations (e.g., NVIDIA at ~75x).

### **Where to Verify?**
- [Nasdaq Official Holdings](https://indexes.nasdaq.com/)
- [Yahoo Finance (NDX)](https://finance.yahoo.com/quote/NDX/)
- [Bloomberg (NDX Components)](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/NDX:IND)
